parsed_response.rationale:
The current low-level goals (LLGs) comprehensively cover the parent high-level goal (HLG) of 'Support accurate and timely product inventory management'. Each LLG is documentarily supported, non-redundant, and correctly scopes the responsibilities of the Administrator actor. The system interactions are clearly defined and do not require manual triggers by the actor for documented effects.

1. llg_001 (Administrator sets reorder threshold for product) - Documented and supported; sets a configurable minimum stock level that triggers an automatic reorder request.
2. llg_002 (System updates inventory in real-time upon product receipt) - Documented and supported; automatically adjusts inventory counts when goods are received and verified by the goods-receiving staff.
3. llg_003 (Administrator initiates manual replenishment for product) - Documented and supported; allows the administrator to manually trigger a replenishment request when real-time inventory falls below a desired level or when automatic triggers are disabled.
4. llg_004 (System triggers automatic reorder when inventory reaches threshold) - Documented and supported; automatically initiates a reorder request to a predefined supplier when the inventory level for a product falls below the configured reorder threshold.
5. llg_005 (System sends automatic reorder request to supplier with 2-working-day confirmation deadline) - Documented and supported; sends an automatic reorder request to a predefined supplier, with a 2-working-day deadline for supplier confirmation, and logs the request status.

All essential capabilities of the parent HLG are present in the LLGs, and there is no redundancy or missing functionality. The LLGs accurately reflect documentary support, correct scope, and non-duplication of system interactions or effects.
